messages: Maya Chen: Quick design pass on the playground stream: I prototyped a 'Capture snapshot' action instead of 'Stop' so it's clearer we keep the partial output as a static message. Thoughts? Devin Patel: I like that wording. Couple questions: keyboard shortcut? behavior on regenerate? append new response or replace snapshot? Maya Chen: Proposal: Esc toggles live/paused, Cmd+. opens overflow. Regenerate appends a new message so snapshot stays as a point-in-time record. Sasha Rivera: If we append we need a clear 'Overwrite' affordance so users can intentionally replace snapshots. Also A11y: announce snapshot captured via aria-live="polite" but avoid noisy updates while streaming. Alan Ng: Token counter placement idea: compact token pill in the message footer (right-aligned). Hover shows cost estimate. Keeps header clean. Jyoti Rao: For the token pill ensure 4.5:1 contrast, keyboard focusable, aria-label like 'Message tokens: 48'. Don't have it announce on every partial update. Devin Patel: Implementation thought: use aria-live="polite" for the stream container, but token updates live in an offscreen region that is toggled so SRs can query final value on demand. Maya Chen: Posted a Figma: https://figma.com/s/mini-shelf-capture (preview). Current microcopy: 'Capture snapshot', 'Regenerate', 'Resume stream', 'Overwrite snapshot'. Feedback? Sasha Rivera: Microcopy tweak: 'Overwrite snapshot' might be too aggressive. Maybe 'Replace snapshot' is softer. And tooltip should explain capture: 'Capture a static copy of the current response.' Maya Chen: I worry 'Save' implies persistence. 'Capture' feels momentary which is the point. Alan Ng: Agreed on 'Capture'. For capture UX add 300ms debounce and a quick flash animation so accidental double taps are obvious. Playground Bot: TokenEstimator: estimated tokens for last partial: 48 tokens. Cost est: $0.00024. Maya Chen: Can the bot status be styled as a tiny chip and excluded from exports by default? Sasha Rivera: Yes, exports should have a toggle: include system metadata / exclude system metadata. Snapshots included by default. Alan Ng: HTML prototype for token pill: `` and a visually-hidden `Estimated cost $0.00024`. Jyoti Rao: Make sure the pill is in the tab order and the description is read only when focused. Use aria-describedby rather than live region. Maya Chen: Mini prompt-shelf plan: slide-in shelf with pinned prompts, keyboard nav (arrow keys + Enter), drag-to-pin, and filter. Insert shows toast 'Prompt inserted 12 Undo' (Undo link). Devin Patel: Filter debounce 200ms. After insert, keep focus in composer and show undo toast. Also map Esc to resume stream. Sasha Rivera: Toast copy: 'Inserted prompt — Undo' (Undo action). Ensure focus management returns to composer and toast is reachable by SR users if they want to Undo. Jyoti Rao: I'll draft accessibility acceptance criteria: contrast, focus order, aria labels, no repetitive live-region announcements during streaming, SR-friendly toasts. Maya Chen: Action items: 1) Capture debounce + animation prototype (Alan/Devin) 2) Token pill + aria-desc prototype (Alan/Jyoti) 3) Microcopy finalization (Sasha/Maya) 4) Prompt-shelf keyboard nav + undo toast (Devin/Sasha) 5) Export toggle for system metadata (Product ops). Alan Ng: I'll prototype 1 & 2, targeting EOD tomorrow. Devin Patel: I'll own 4 and wire keyboard shortcuts. Jyoti Rao: I'll write the a11y criteria and tests. Sasha Rivera: I'll draft final microcopy and tooltips. Maya Chen: Thanks all. If no blockers I'll update the figma and post the spec this afternoon. :sparkles:
